issue_context.title: _geoPoint is not updated after updating the document's latitude and longitude
comments:
Hello,

here is a workaround for this bug:

- This bug happens when only the `_geo` fields of a document are updated.
- To avoid the bug, one can update another filterable field at the same time as the `_geo` field.
- To fix any missing entry, one can force `_geo` reindexing by sending a first settings task that removes `_geo` from filterable/sortable fields, **wait for that task to be fully processed**, and then send a new settings task that adds back `_geo` to `filterable/sortable` fields.

A definitive fix is scheduled for v1.14
